name: Treasure of the Phoenix
summary: In Treasure of the Phoenix you guide a powerful eagle through the deadly chambers of King Tut's tomb. Magical traps such as spears, saws, and boulders make your journey perilous. The second chamber is filled with demonic minions, and reaching the third leads to a mysterious realm no mortal has ever seen – said to be guarded by an eternal phoenix. Only skill, reflexes, and courage will let you uncover the tomb's secrets.
